name: Expense Tracker - Email to Supabase (Groq AI)

parameters.content:
## STEP 1 — Trigger
Watches Gmail for new emails.
Default filter: subject contains "expense".
Change the filter (or point it at a Gmail label) if you want.

⚙️ Needs: Gmail OAuth2 credential

## STEP 2 — AI Extraction
Groq LLM reads the Subject + Body and returns structured expense JSON (amount, category, date, etc.) via a Structured Output Parser, so the shape is always consistent.

⚙️ Needs: Groq API credential
(free key: console.groq.com/keys)

parameters.text:
=You are an expert financial data-extraction assistant. Read the email below and extract the expense details.

Email Subject: {{ $json.headers.subject }}
Email Received Date: {{ $json.headers.date }}
Email Body:
{{ $json.textPlain }}

Rules:
- amount: the numeric expense amount only (no currency symbol, no commas, no text).
- currency: 3-letter code if identifiable. If the email uses "Rs." or "Rupees", use "PKR". Default to "PKR" if unclear.
- category: classify into exactly one of: Food & Dining, Transport, Shopping, Bills & Utilities, Groceries, Entertainment, Health, Travel, Education, Other.
- description: a short (max 8 words) plain-English summary of what the expense was for.
- merchant: the shop/vendor/place name if mentioned, else "Unknown".
- payment_method: e.g. Easypaisa, JazzCash, Credit Card, Debit Card, Cash, Bank Transfer. If not mentioned, "Unknown".
- expense_date: the calendar date the expense actually happened, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. Resolve relative words like "today" or "yesterday" using the Email Received Date above as the reference point.

If a field truly cannot be determined, use null for amount and "Unknown" for text fields. Respond with the structured fields only — no commentary.

parameters.content:
## STEP 3 — Save + Fetch
Inserts the parsed expense into the Supabase "expenses" table, then reads back ALL rows so the report can total everything.

⚙️ Needs: Supabase credential
(Project URL + service_role key)

## STEP 4 — Report Email
Builds an HTML summary (this new expense + all-time totals by category) and emails it to you.

⚙️ Update "sendTo" in the last node with your own email address.
